caption: The drawing depicts a single stylized rooster, standing in profile facing to the right. The rooster is rendered in muted greenish-gray tones with a smooth, uniform application of color and subtle shading that suggests a metallic or patinated surface. Its tail feathers are large, fanned, and decorated with a repetitive leaf-like pattern, while the wing feathers are more simplified and curved. The rooster stands on two straight legs that are attached to a flat, oval base. The head is upright with a small round eye, a short beak, and no visible comb or wattles. The background is plain and off-white, without any additional objects, patterns, or scenery.
title: Rooster Weather Vane
